title: Return It Deep
style: world jazz, female lead vocal, kora and brass, walking bass, 94 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
The return of serve sets the tone.
Not the serve. The return.
In every language, same power.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Return deep, return low
Get it back and let it flow
Don't go for the winner yet
Get in position, no regret

[VERSE 2 - Lingala transliteration]
Zonga mozindo, zonga na se
Bimisa ye mpamba mpe tika akola
Okimi na winner naino te
Kota na esika, pamba te

[VERSE 3 - Macedonian transliteration]
Vrati dlaboko, vrati nisko
Vrati ja i neka tece
Oste ne jurish po pobedata
Zazemi pozicija, bez zalenje

[CHORUS]
RETURN - ZONGA - VRATI - KTHEJE
DEEP AND LOW - GET IN PLACE
RETURN THE SERVE - EVERY TIME
POSITION FIRST - EVERY GAME

[VERSE 4 - Tagalog transliteration]
Ibalik nang malalim, ibalik nang mababa
Ipadala ito at hayaang dumaan
Huwag pang hanapin ang panalo
Pumasok sa posisyon, walang pagsisisi

[VERSE 5 - Northern Sami transliteration]
Palase njiucat, palase vuolde
Faset ruovttoluotta ja satta valdit
Ale oainnat vuoittima vel
Mannat sajis, allos balu

[VERSE 6 - Guarani transliteration]
Ejevuelta nde ypykueguare, ejevuelta pe yvate guive
Emondo hagua oho
Anirete eheka ovecha
Eike ndekueve, ani mbae

[CHORUS]
RETURN - ZONGA - VRATI - KTHEJE
DEEP AND LOW - GET IN PLACE
RETURN THE SERVE - EVERY TIME
POSITION FIRST - EVERY GAME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Lingala. Northern Sami. Guarani.
The return is your first move.
Deep. Low. In position.
Own the rally from ball two.

[FINAL CHORUS]
RETURN - ZONGA - VRATI - KTHEJE
DEEP AND LOW - GET IN PLACE
RETURN THE SERVE - EVERY TIME
POSITION FIRST - EVERY GAME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE RETURN
GET IN PLACE - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Return it deep.
